name: Mount Shanin
description: Mountain where Sekena met a fully-grown dragon.

timeline.summary: On Mount Shanin Sekena bonds with a fully-grown dragon and later finds her mother and sister chased by goblins; the dragon kills the goblins and she is reunited with her family.
timeline.quote: The dragon roasted the goblins and feasted on their corpses, while Sekena was reunited with her family.
